Title: Retrieve customer by name and phone with maximum allowed name length (255 characters)
Preconditions: A customer with a 255-character name and valid phone exists in the system
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/customers/by-name-phone?name=<255_char_name>&phone=1234567890 with the payload in testData.

Test Data: {"name": "A very long name that reaches exactly 255 characters including spaces and punctuation marks to test the boundary limit of the name field in the customer entity which is set to 255 characters maximum allowed length...", "phone": "1234567890"}
Expected Result: The API responds with a 200 OK status code, a status of 'success', and the customer details in the 'data' field.

Title: Retrieve customer by name and phone with name exceeding maximum allowed length (256 characters)
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/customers/by-name-phone?name=<256_char_name>&phone=1234567890 with the payload in testData.

Test Data: {"name": "A very long name that exceeds the 255 characters limit by exactly one character to test the boundary limit of the name field in the customer entity which is set to 255 characters maximum allowed length and this is the extra character...", "phone": "1234567890"}
Expected Result: The API responds with a 404 Not Found status code, a status of 'error', and a message indicating 'Customer not found with name: <256_char_name> and phone: 1234567890'.
